location: independent standalone science/source-loss-synchrony-sign-gate-v1-246 branch; does not reopen original GEB
scientific_question: When source loss removes donor support, can changed synchrony of surviving sources reverse the sign of complete source-delivery interruptions? This is a one-step rescue-window mechanism, not an equivalence to metapopulation persistence.

published_priors.study: Fox et al. 2017 Nature Ecology & Evolution
published_priors.original_result: repeated catastrophic local extinctions promoted experimental predator persistence under otherwise synchronizing high-dispersal regimes; already published

published_priors.study: Matter & Roland 2010 Proc R Soc B
published_priors.original_result: experimentally removed two subpopulations in a 17-meadow butterfly network; immigration decreased and residual meadow population synchrony increased; global extinction rate was NOT observed to increase during the field study

not_new_vs_existing_Structural.v1_203_known_truth: Previous v1.203 already proved equal first and second source moments do not determine complete all-source failure; do NOT repeat as a new insight.
not_new_vs_existing_Structural.v1_144_BALA_primary: Independent three-wave retrospective source-leverage outcome failed its primary C-R2; its endpoint and inference remain unchanged.
not_new_vs_existing_Structural.GEB_v0_42: zero eligible confirmatory systems, no v0.31-v0.42 gate bypass

mathematical_definition.baseline_joint: P_before on binary source delivery states X=(A,B,C) at a fixed target and forecast lag
mathematical_definition.post_loss_joint: P_after on binary states (A,B) after removal and dynamic response
mathematical_definition.dynamic: q_after-q_static; can have either sign even when A,B marginals unchanged
mathematical_definition.strict_hydra_condition: q_static-q_after>direct (the dynamic reduction in surviving-source failure exceeds lost unique donor opportunities)
mathematical_definition.pure_static_theorem: with no change in remaining source-state law q_after=q_static, donor deletion cannot reduce complete source failure at the specified target and lag

fixed_known_truth_scenarios: C independent P(active)=0.4 and A/B identical Bernoulli(.5); C removed with A/B unchanged => q_before=.3, q_after=.5, direct=.2
same initial but A/B independently Bernoulli(.5) after removal => q_before=.3, q_after=.25; direct=.2 dynamic=-.25 net=-.05
A/B independent Bernoulli(.5), C independent Bernoulli(.4), after C removal A/B synchronize with the SAME .5 marginals => q_before=.15, q_after=.5; direct=.1 dynamic=+.25 net=+.35
empirical_admission_requirements: One focal target/island, fixed donor roster and measured actual source-to-target effective delivery X_i(t)
Measured pre-loss unique-donor activity and joint all-zero probability, repeated before and after intervention
Control patch/focal site, randomized or defensibly exogenous source loss and independent replicate metapopulations
Survey detection, prey/environment common shocks and actual donor movement measured, not graph adjacency
Separate local population synchronization from observed ecosystem-wide time to extinction
Prospective split across independent systems and the original v0.31-v0.42 gates before target outcomes
